scene_instantiation.mode: official USD copy and direct PhysX parsing

scene_geometry.status_scope: component CPU readiness; caller records actual hook use/physics validation separately

provider.policy_height_feature: analytical declared reference plane with feature-only padding; TRACE and physics retain all walls/unknown blockers
provider.scene_stage_owner: pinned SDK public get_current_stage; honors current thread-local use_stage; no global omni.usd fallback
provider.spawn_orientation_contract: fixed SDK XYZW identity (0,0,0,1) only; one untransformed global source

scene_geometry.ROS_export_layout: row0=maxY,column0=minX; cell-center world coordinates; no dynamic layout fitting
scene_geometry.clearance_method: EDT center distance minus two cell half-diagonals; padded blocked exterior; full candidate cell certified
scene_geometry.astar: 8-connected, no diagonal corner cutting; optional explicit certified start connector; no physical relocation
scene_geometry.failure_behavior: hold actual finite root as explicit failed query; never count navigation success
scene_geometry.SDF: lazy Torch bilinear signed-grid proxy plus analytic forbidden exterior; soft guidance only
scene_geometry.SDF_sampling: four-corner immutable-table lookup; world-weight gradients only; no grid_sample CUDA backward
limitations: Native resource admission is a static snapshot, not new provider cooking/navigation validation.
A conservative .1m map is not exact full-body swept-volume or contact clearance.
A* supplies global waypoints only; it does not replace diffusion output or move physical actors.
Grid SDF needs the separately owned explicit planner callback hook; AABB geometry cannot substitute for measured occupancy.

native_scene_provider.policy_height_feature: analytical declared reference plane with feature-only padding; TRACE and physics retain all walls/unknown blockers
native_scene_provider.scene_stage_owner: pinned SDK public get_current_stage; honors current thread-local use_stage; no global omni.usd fallback
native_scene_provider.spawn_orientation_contract: fixed SDK XYZW identity (0,0,0,1) only; one untransformed global source

native_scene_live_observation.counter_semantics: actual Lab submitted-step counter; no claimed native engine timestamp
limitations: Finite all-hit native ray samples verify current support at reset/sample points, not every world point or swept body.
Current singleton/context and stage identity are observed; App/context historical constructor counts are not measured.
No physical steps, pose writes, new world, query view, or source USD save is performed.

physical_contact_measurement.substep_reduction: maximum body-pair magnitude over every physics substep; strict > threshold

floor_measurement.force_semantics: filtered normal-force vector sums; friction excluded
floor_measurement.side_load_semantics: sum foot-vector magnitudes for ankle and toe; not scalar patch-force sum
floor_measurement.contact_semantics: strict > threshold per foot; side contact is any ankle/toe contact
floor_measurement.slip_semantics: optional body-origin tangential-speed proxy on declared plane; not contact-point slip
floor_measurement.floor_geometry_role: explicit caller-selected enabled floor colliders; no automatic all-static filter

ground_support_contract.counter_semantics: monotonic submitted-step counter; not PhysX native simulation time
ground_support_contract.episode_source: world.episode_ids before control and every completed substep
ground_support_contract.local_com_source: root_view.get_coms() local position and principal-axis pose
ground_support_contract.static_channel_transport: validated get_coms/get_masses values copied to live body-state dtype/device; no geometric recomputation
